summary: Verified admin login fix (Pass123$$). Backend strip-tolerant check_admin() and frontend trim(keyInput) both confirmed working via pytest (23 tests) and Playwright E2E on /admin. Correct key logs in; wrong key rejected; trailing-whitespace key logs in and stored trimmed in localStorage; all 3 admin tabs render; logout works.

critical_code_review_comments: check_admin() correctly uses (admin_key or '').strip() != ADMIN_KEY.strip() — safe against None + whitespace.
Frontend submitKey() trims and stores trimmed key to localStorage — verified stored value has no whitespace.
Fallback URL in previous backend_test.py was outdated; replaced with dotenv-loaded REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env so tests always target the current deployment.
test_credentials: Admin key: Pass123$$ (from backend/.env ADMIN_KEY). localStorage key: hredu_admin_key.

context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env via python-dotenv. Whitespace-tolerant admin verify covered by test_admin_verify_trailing_space and test_admin_verify_leading_space (uses tab char since requests forbids leading whitespace in header values).
rca of the issue: User's 'Pass123$$ did not work' was caused by (a) copy-paste whitespace and/or (b) stale hredu_admin_key in localStorage. Fix: backend strips both sides in check_admin(); frontend trims keyInput before verify/store; logout removes stored key. Verified end-to-end: trailing-space input succeeds and stored value equals 'Pass123$$' with no whitespace.
